comment: Every font of the mod: build_fonts.py turns each entry into OpenZone_Research/gui/fonts/<name>.fnt + .edds. kind bitmap = FNT3 (TextWidget; sharpest at the sizes it was built for), kind sdf = FNT5 distance field (the only kind MultilineTextWidget and RichTextWidget scale). cell = the cell height in pixels (the atlas resolution, not the size on screen: a layout sets that with "exact text size"). See README.md.
